answer_1.quote: We prompt LLaVA-1.5 with an image and the instruction "Please describe the image in detail" to generate descriptions, calculating the VHD scores when predicting the first token.

answer_2.quote: We report the average results for each metric along with the standard deviation. Metrics include CHAIR S/I, POPE Accuracy/Precision/Recall/F1, and Len.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4V model to evaluate the LVLMs' outputs in LLaVA-Bench (In-the-Wild) and GPT-4o for pairwise response comparison, scoring accuracy, detailedness, and naturalness.
